## Purpose

This Draft PR is a fresh immutable CI snapshot of the accepted frontend parity and member-reveal source at 9d79abcf1f5c498687c2e5c443e3edf220070aa6, against the unchanged ancestor 77993819c233737f1e2b4c11c8ca1a5d360bcbe3. It does not move or rerun the original PR1218 snapshot.

## Scope

The source retains the accepted three producer fixes, the generic waitRead deadline fix, the complete149-case Node aggregate, the43-case catalog file, the unchanged85-case renderer file, and the bounded same-Alice reveal before the original member click. Workflow bytes, filters, dependencies, deadlines and strict native assertions are unchanged.

The opened Draft event selects the existing Host Emulated, Packaged, OpenCode V2 Stage1, Announcements and CI fast-feedback families. Claude/Codex routes use the existing finite TEST peers; the declared actual OpenCode paths remain separately bounded. Full qualification is expected to fail the unchanged Draft policy; CodeQL and OpenCode diagnostics are expected Draft skips. Every other failure, skip, cancellation, unavailable artifact or unreached step remains explicit.
